a.notes: pages 1+: Pages 1 and 3 contain no numeric results of the paper's own analyses (only design parameters such as stimulus durations, dB levels, ITI/CTOA distributions, trial counts, and display specifications, which were excluded per instructions). Fig. 1 (p. 3) is a trial outline with design durations only. Fig. 2 (p. 3) shows a model fit for a single subject but prints no numeric parameter values. Fig. 3 (p. 4) bar charts print no numeric values on the bars; only the significance markers (* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01) are printed, and these were extracted as figure claims. The bracket groupings (which condition pairs each marker refers to) were determined visually from the figure and should be verified against the full text of the paper. | pages 5+: All four page images (journal pages 77-80) were readable. No tables or figures with printed numeric result values appear on these pages (Fig. 4 is a trial outline; Fig. 5 has no printed result values beyond axis labels). All extracted results come from the text, including footnote 1 (likelihood ratio model comparisons). SD = 0.52 mm for the 85 dB early-window peak is reported as printed. | pages 9+: Page 9 (page 81 of the journal) contains only the reference list of Petersen et al., Cognition 165 (2017) 73-81. No statistical results (coefficients, test statistics, p-values, means, etc.) from the paper's own analyses are reported on this page, so no claims were extracted.
